AboutSection.purpose: Site section: story beside a picture

Accordion.purpose: One collapsible section: a clickable title row that shows and hides its content

AccordionGroup.purpose: Stack of Accordions from an items array, with optional auto-collapse — FAQs and disclosure lists

AdapterProvider.purpose: The app's link and image components for every Once UI link and image; core/next's LayoutProvider installs Next's

Animation.purpose: Preset enter/exit animation (fade, scale, slide, blur) on hover, click or a controlled trigger

Arrow.purpose: Small arrow that slides in while its trigger element is hovered, on a card or link

Avatar.purpose: Round profile picture with initials or icon fallback and an optional status dot

AvatarGroup.purpose: Overlapping stack of avatars with a limit and an overflow count

Background.purpose: Absolute decorative layer: gradients, dots, grid, lines and masks behind a section's content

Banner.purpose: Full-width brand-coloured strip across the top of a page for an announcement

BarChart.purpose: Bar chart for categorical series, with axes, legend, tooltip, loading and empty states

BlobFx.purpose: Drifting blurred colour blobs as an ambient background layer

BlockQuote.purpose: Semantic <blockquote> with optional preline, subline and author link — testimonials and pull quotes
BlockQuote.avoid: Sizing it above the section titles (display-strong-xs/s) around it

Book.purpose: Book cover rendered in 3D with spine and page block, tilting on hover; optional link

Breadcrumbs.purpose: Trail of links to the current page, with the last marked current and long trails collapsed

Button.purpose: Action or link button with variants, sizes, prefix/suffix icons and a loading state

Card.purpose: Interactive surface — a clickable or linked panel with hover feedback; requires href or onClick
Card.avoid: Static panels (pricing tiers, testimonials, stats) — use Column + surface recipe

Carousel.purpose: Image slideshow with arrows, dots or thumbnails and autoplay; mode="snap" is a touch track (2.x Swiper)

CelebrationFx.purpose: Canvas confetti or fireworks burst for a completed milestone

ChartHeader.purpose: Title, description and date-range picker with presets above a chart

ChartStatus.purpose: Loading, empty and error placeholder a chart shows in place of its plot

ChatComposer.purpose: Chat input bar: growing field, Enter to send, optional attach button with file chips, send button

ChatMessage.purpose: One chat message: bubble, author, time and delivery status; from="self" sits right, grouped hides the name

ChatMessageList.purpose: Scrolling log of ChatMessages that stays pinned to the newest message; onReachStart loads history

Checkbox.purpose: Checkbox with label and description, including an indeterminate state

CodeBlock.purpose: Syntax-highlighted code with tabs, copy button and optional live preview (needs prismjs)

ColorInput.purpose: Colour picker field showing the hex value and a swatch, with optional alpha

Column.purpose: Vertical flex layout — default direction column

CompareImage.purpose: Before/after comparison: two images or panes split by a draggable divider

ContactSection.purpose: Site section: contact details as links

ConversationItem.purpose: Inbox row: avatar, name, last message, time and unread count; a link with href, a button with onClick

CountdownFx.purpose: Animated countdown to a target date, as rolling wheels or plain digits

CountFx.purpose: Animated number that counts or rolls to its value — stats and prices; speed in ms

CtaSection.purpose: Site section: the closing call to action

DataThemeProvider.purpose: App-wide chart defaults (variant, mode, height, axis, ticks); read with useDataTheme

DataTooltip.purpose: Tooltip body for charts: label, series swatches and formatted values

DateInput.purpose: Field that opens a calendar for a date, optionally with time; `range` gives start and end fields

DatePicker.purpose: Inline calendar for a date and optional time, with min/max; `range` picks a range

Dialog.purpose: Modal dialog with title, description, footer and focus handling; variant="sheet" is a bottom sheet (2.x Modal)

Drawer.purpose: Modal sheet that slides in from any edge, with focus trap and scroll lock: mobile nav, filters, side panels

Dropdown.purpose: Trigger and the floating menu it opens, with arrow keys; openOn="contextmenu" for right-click (2.x ContextMenu)

Effect.purpose: One slot for the interchangeable ambient effects (blob, matrix, weather, particle, celebration)

EmojiPicker.purpose: Searchable emoji grid by category; with trigger it opens in a Dropdown (2.x EmojiPickerDropdown)

Fade.purpose: Gradient fade strip at the edge of a scroll container, optionally blurred or patterned
Fade.avoid: Wrapping content — it is an absolute edge overlay, not a container

Feedback.purpose: Inline alert with variant colour, icon, title, description and optional close

FileTree.purpose: Accessible hierarchical file and folder explorer with selection and expandable folders

Flex.purpose: Layout primitive every component builds on — use directly only when direction changes at breakpoints
Flex.avoid: Static row/column layouts — use Row or Column instead

FlipFx.purpose: Card that flips between a front and back face on click, timer or control

Field.purpose: Label, hint and error around one control, with the id and aria attributes wired for you

Fieldset.purpose: Titled form section: a real fieldset with legend and description, laying its fields out like a Form grid

FocusTrap.purpose: Keeps Tab focus inside a region while active, with Escape handling and focus restore on close

Form.purpose: Grid of form fields with one density, and an onSubmit whose promise drives a pending state

FormErrorSummary.purpose: Every form error in one alert after a failed submit, each linking to and focusing its field

GlitchFx.purpose: Glitch distortion on any block, on hover or continuous

Grid.purpose: CSS grid with columns per breakpoint and every Flex prop; `masonry` flows uneven items down columns

Heading.purpose: Semantic h1–h6 with display and heading variants
Heading.avoid: Layout props: it takes padding, margin, flex and s={{ hide }} but no other breakpoint props, border, radius or background; wrap it in a Row for those. A key cap is Kbd

HeadingLink.purpose: Section heading with an anchor link, picked up by HeadingNav for the table of contents

HeadingNav.purpose: Auto-generated table of contents from the page's headings, highlighting the section in view

HeroSection.purpose: Site section: h1, lead, buttons, picture

HoloFx.purpose: Holographic sheen and texture over an image or card, following the pointer

HoverCard.purpose: Rich card on hover or focus of a trigger: beside it, following the pointer ("cursor", 2.x CursorCard) or over it ("cover")

Icon.purpose: Icon by IconName from spec.json iconNames — never invent names

IconButton.purpose: Icon-only button with tooltip; give it an accessible label

IconProvider.purpose: Adds icons to the built-in set or replaces them, by name, for Icon and every icon prop

InfiniteScroll.purpose: Renders items and calls loadMore as the end scrolls into view

InlineCode.purpose: Inline code span inside running text

Input.purpose: Text field with label, description, error, prefix/suffix and validation; `type="password"` adds a show/hide toggle

Kbar.purpose: Command palette opened with ⌘K: searchable sections of links and actions

Kbd.purpose: Keyboard key as a key cap; with `keys` a whole shortcut (⌘ on Apple platforms, Ctrl elsewhere) beside its action

LayoutProvider.purpose: Root provider for breakpoints with next/link and next/image, for Next.js apps, from core/next

Legend.purpose: Chart legend: series swatches and labels, as a row or column

LetterFx.purpose: Scrambles text through random characters before settling on it

LinearGauge.purpose: Horizontal tick gauge for a value against a range — progress, health, capacity

LinearGradient.purpose: SVG linear gradient definition for chart fills

LineBarChart.purpose: Combined line and bar series on shared axes

LineChart.purpose: Line or area chart for trends over time, with axes, legend, tooltip and states

ListItem.purpose: One item in a List, with Text typography props

Logo.purpose: Brand mark and/or wordmark with light/dark sources and an optional link

LogoCloud.purpose: Grid of partner or customer logos with optional rotation — always set columns

LogoSpinner.purpose: Once UI mark loader, for AI and brand loading states

LogosSection.purpose: Site section: client or press logos

Mascot.purpose: Animated assistant character: one-color shape with eyes; states, moods, pulses with audio

Map.purpose: Themed map on free tiles with React markers and a controlled viewport (needs maplibre-gl)

MapCircle.purpose: Area in metres, e.g. an approximate address

MapMarker.purpose: React content at a map position

MapMarkers.purpose: Markers from data, clustered, one active

MapPin.purpose: Marker look: label pill or dot

MapPopup.purpose: Card above a map position; Escape closes

Mask.purpose: Radial mask over its content, fixed or following the cursor

MatrixFx.purpose: Canvas dot-matrix field with reveal, flicker and an optional bulge wave

MdxBlockQuote.purpose: What `> quote` renders in the MDX map: BlockQuote with body-text lines; wrap it to restyle quotes

MdxCodeBlock.purpose: What a fenced code block renders in the MDX map: CodeBlock with the fence's language and a copy button

MdxHeading.purpose: What `#`–`######` render in the MDX map: a Heading with a slug id and a copy-link anchor; takes as and margins

MdxHeadingAnchor.purpose: The link to #id next to an MDX heading, shown on hover or focus; copies the section URL with a toast

MdxHr.purpose: What `---` renders in the MDX map: a Line with the separator role

MdxImage.purpose: What `![alt](src)` renders in the MDX map: Media through the image adapter, enlarge on click

MdxInlineCode.purpose: What `code` in backticks renders in the MDX map: InlineCode

MdxLink.purpose: What `[text](href)` renders in the MDX map: an underlined SmartLink, router for paths, new tab for URLs

MdxList.purpose: What `-` and `1.` lists render in the MDX map: List as ul or ol, keeping an ordered list's start

MdxListItem.purpose: A list item in the MDX map: ListItem with body line height

MdxParagraph.purpose: Body text in the MDX map; a paragraph that is only an image renders the image, never a div inside a p

MdxTable.purpose: What a GFM table renders in the MDX map: Table with the header row and column alignment (needs remark-gfm)

Media.purpose: Image, YouTube or MP4 by src, with aspect ratio, loading state, caption and enlarge

MediaAudioPlayer.purpose: Audio player with play/pause, seek bar and time; reports playback position (import from components/MediaAudioPlayer)

MediaUpload.purpose: Drag-and-drop image upload with preview, compression and resizing (needs compressorjs)

MediaVideoPlayer.purpose: Video player with play/pause, seek bar and time, for sources Media cannot sniff (import from components/MediaVideoPlayer)

MegaMenu.purpose: Top navigation with dropdown panels of grouped links; `collapseBelow` stacks them as accordions

Meta.purpose: Meta.generate: Next.js metadata with Open Graph and Twitter cards

Nav.purpose: Sidebar navigation that sets density, variant and rail once for every NavItem, NavGroup and NavSection

NavGroup.purpose: Collapsible group of NavItems in a sidebar, indented behind a rail

NavIcon.purpose: Hamburger button that toggles to a close icon, for opening mobile navigation

NavItem.purpose: One sidebar navigation row: label, icon, selected state, count badge or unread dot

NavSection.purpose: Titled block of sidebar rows with an optional heading action, such as Projects with an add button

NextAdapterProvider.purpose: Installs the next/link and next/image adapters alone, for an app that composes its own LayoutProvider

NumberInput.purpose: Numeric field with increment/decrement controls, bounded by min, max and step

OgCard.purpose: Link preview card built from a URL's Open Graph data

OgRoutesProvider.purpose: Points OgCard and useOgData at the app's OG routes, made with createOgFetchRoute and createOgProxyRoute from core/next

Option.purpose: Selectable row in a menu, dropdown or select: label, description, prefix/suffix, link or click

OTPInput.purpose: One box per digit for a verification code, with paste and a completion callback

Pagination.purpose: Page buttons in a nav landmark with previous/next, ellipses and an optional per-page select

ParticleFx.purpose: Drifting particles that can react to the pointer, as an ambient layer

PieChart.purpose: Pie or donut chart of parts of a whole, with legend and tooltip

PricingSection.purpose: Site section: plans side by side, one highlighted

ProgressBar.purpose: Linear progress bar for a value between min and max, with optional label

RadialGauge.purpose: Circular or arc tick gauge for a single metric with a centre readout

RadialGradient.purpose: SVG radial gradient definition for chart fills

RadioButton.purpose: Radio button with label and description for one-of-many choices

RadioGroup.purpose: One choice from a set of radios as one form field, with arrow keys, from options or RadioButtons

Reaction.purpose: One emoji or image reaction with its own gesture (beat, nod…)

Reactions.purpose: Reaction chips with counts, picker and burst, for posts and chat

RevealFx.purpose: Slide-and-fade entrance for a block; delay and speed in ms — one coherent set per page

Row.purpose: Horizontal flex layout — default direction row

Schema.purpose: Schema.org JSON-LD script for a page, article or organization

Scroller.purpose: Scrolling row with arrows and fades; track props make a carousel track, auto a marquee (2.x AutoScroll)

ScrollLock.purpose: Freezes page scroll while enabled, keeping one referenced region scrollable

ScrollToTop.purpose: Floating button that appears after a scroll offset and returns to the top

Scrubber.purpose: Seek bar with a playhead; with tracks, an editor timeline of movable, trimmable blocks

Sections.purpose: Renders stored sections [{ type, props }]; fields in sectionSchemas

SegmentedControl.purpose: Pick one of 2–5 options from a row of buttons (billing period, view mode)

Select.purpose: Dropdown select for one or many options, with optional search

Setting.purpose: Settings row: label and description left, one control right; `axes` for X/Y pairs, `control` and `open` for a group

ShineFx.purpose: Shine sweeping across text; speed in ms

Skeleton.purpose: Loading placeholder shape (line, block, circle) with a staggerable delay in ms

Slider.purpose: Slider for a number, or with `range` a [start, end] pair; label, readout, error and size

SmartLink.purpose: Styled link with prefix/suffix icons and a selected state; routes through the framework adapter

Sortable.purpose: List people reorder by mouse, touch or keyboard; lists sharing a group trade rows
Sortable.avoid: Native HTML5 draggable, which does nothing on touch and has no keyboard path

SortableHandle.purpose: Grip button a Sortable row drags by when the list has handle; drags at once on touch

SortableItem.purpose: One row of a Sortable, wrapping a NavItem, Card or any row unchanged

Spinner.purpose: Rotating loader for async and streaming states

SplitView.purpose: Two panes with a draggable divider, collapsing to one below a breakpoint

StatsSection.purpose: Site section: a few large figures

StatusIndicator.purpose: Small status dot (online, error, warning) by palette hue; `pulse` adds a pulsing ring for a live state

StyleOverlay.purpose: Wraps a trigger (an IconButton) that opens StylePanel in a floating side panel; fits CodeBlock's actions

StylePanel.purpose: Live theming controls for theme, colours, shape and density; or compose StylePanelRoot and its parts

StylePanelAccent.purpose: StylePanel row: accent colour swatches (custom adds one of the host's own); inside a StylePanelRoot

StylePanelAdvanced.purpose: StylePanel group with the Surface, Density, Scaling, DataStyle and Transition rows; inside a StylePanelRoot

StylePanelBodyLineHeight.purpose: StylePanel row: body text line height; inside a StylePanelRoot

StylePanelBodySize.purpose: StylePanel row: body text size; inside a StylePanelRoot

StylePanelBodyText.purpose: StylePanel group with the BodySize and BodyLineHeight rows; inside a StylePanelRoot

StylePanelBrand.purpose: StylePanel row: brand colour swatches (custom adds one of the host's own); inside a StylePanelRoot

StylePanelColor.purpose: StylePanel group with the Brand, Accent and Neutral rows; inside a StylePanelRoot

StylePanelDataStyle.purpose: StylePanel row: chart colour mode; needs a DataThemeProvider; inside a StylePanelRoot

StylePanelDensity.purpose: StylePanel row: spacing density (compact, normal, spacious); inside a StylePanelRoot

StylePanelEffect.purpose: StylePanel row: solid effect (flat, plastic); inside a StylePanelRoot

StylePanelGroup.purpose: Titled group of StylePanel rows inside a StylePanelRoot

StylePanelNeutral.purpose: StylePanel row: neutral colour swatches; inside a StylePanelRoot

StylePanelPage.purpose: StylePanel group with the Theme and Shape rows; inside a StylePanelRoot

StylePanelRoot.purpose: Holds a composed StylePanel's state (bound to ThemeProvider, or controlled by value); wraps StylePanel sections

StylePanelRow.purpose: Labelled StylePanel row for a control of the host's own

StylePanelScaling.purpose: StylePanel row: interface scaling; inside a StylePanelRoot

StylePanelShape.purpose: StylePanel row: corner shape (sharp to rounded); inside a StylePanelRoot

StylePanelSolid.purpose: StylePanel row: solid fill (color, inverse, contrast); inside a StylePanelRoot

StylePanelSolidStyle.purpose: StylePanel group with the Solid and Effect rows; inside a StylePanelRoot

StylePanelSurface.purpose: StylePanel row: surface style (filled, translucent); inside a StylePanelRoot

StylePanelTheme.purpose: StylePanel row: light, dark or system theme; inside a StylePanelRoot

StylePanelTransition.purpose: StylePanel row: transition style; inside a StylePanelRoot

StyleScope.purpose: Site colours, theme and fonts on one subtree

SubmitButton.purpose: Submit Button that shows a spinner and ignores repeat presses while its Form's async onSubmit runs

Swatch.purpose: Small colour chip marking a chart series

Switch.purpose: On/off toggle with label, description and loading state

Tab.purpose: One tab in a TabList, matched to its TabPanel by value

Table.purpose: Table from column definitions: sorting, search, selection, pagination, row actions, empty and loading states

TabList.purpose: The row or column of Tabs inside Tabs, with arrow-key focus

TabPanel.purpose: The content shown while its Tab is selected

Tabs.purpose: Horizontal or vertical tabs that switch between panels by value — settings sections and grouped views

Tag.purpose: Status or category label with a tone; variant="announce" + href for a 'New' pill; selected/onRemove for a filter token
Tag.avoid: Passing the same text as label and children — the children are dropped

TagInput.purpose: Field that collects a list of values as removable chips

TeamSection.purpose: Site section: people with photo, role and bio

Text.purpose: Body, label and display text with variant, weight and colour tokens
Text.avoid: Layout props: it takes padding, margin, flex and s={{ hide }} but no other breakpoint props, border, radius or background; wrap it in a Row for those. A key cap is Kbd

Textarea.purpose: Multi-line text field that grows with its content by default

ThemeInit.purpose: Head script that applies the theme before first paint, so it never flashes

ThemeProvider.purpose: Root provider for theme and style, persisted; read and set with useTheme and useStyle

ThemeSwitcher.purpose: Light, dark and system theme toggle, optionally collapsed to the active one

TiltFx.purpose: 3D tilt following the pointer, for cards and previews

Timeline.purpose: Steps or events in order down the page — changelogs, histories, processes
Timeline.avoid: A media editor's timeline — use Scrubber

Toast.purpose: One notification message with variant, icon, action and close; shown through useToast
Toast.avoid: Rendering it directly — call addToast from useToast

ToastProvider.purpose: Root provider for toast notifications: renders the toast stack and gives useToast its addToast

ToggleButton.purpose: Button with a selected state, for toolbars, segmented choices and nav rows

Tooltip.purpose: Short hint on hover or focus of its children; with content and no children, an info icon (2.x InfoTip)

TypeFx.purpose: Typewriter that types and deletes a list of words; `mode="fade"` fades letters in instead

TypingIndicator.purpose: Three pulsing dots for someone typing or a reply being generated, with an optional label

User.purpose: Avatar with name, subline and optional tag, an identity row; with dropdown it opens an account menu (2.x UserMenu)

VisuallyHidden.purpose: Content for screen readers only; focusable makes it a skip link that shows on focus

VoiceVisualizer.purpose: Voice chat orb or bars for idle, listening, thinking, speaking; follows audio level

WeatherFx.purpose: Canvas rain, snow, leaves or lightning as an ambient layer

WorkingIndicator.purpose: AI working line: mark loader plus cycling verbs (Imagining…)
